high_level_description: The image is a logo for Cambridge University Press. It features a symmetrical design with four quadrants, each containing a red shield with a golden lion rampant. The lions are depicted in a heraldic style, standing on their hind legs with their front paws raised. Each shield is bordered by a series of black fleur-de-lis symbols, which are evenly spaced and arranged in a pattern that radiates outward from the center. At the center of the design is a smaller, central shield that is also red but contains a golden shield with a single eye in the middle, flanked by two golden lions.
